dma_channel_reg_list
struct
dma_channel_reg_list

Represents the memory-mapped register layout for a single DMA channel.  This structure is packed and 64-byte aligned to ensure strict compatibility with the hardware register block alignment requirements.

Fields
sar

Source Address Register: The 64-bit physical address from which data is read.

dar

Destination Address Register: The 64-bit physical address to which data is written.

block_ts

Block Transfer Size: Configures the total number of data items for the transfer (bits [21:0] active).

llp

Linked List Pointer: Pointer to the next descriptor in a scatter-gather chain (bits [63:6] active).

ctl

Control Register: Contains burst size, addressing increments, and interrupt trigger enable bits.

chn_src_stat

Channel Source Status: Reports current hardware status of the source interface.

chn_dst_stat

Channel Destination Status: Reports current hardware status of the destination interface.

chn_llp_status

Channel LLP Status: The current state of the linked list processing.

reserved

Reserved padding for register block alignment.
